observed_problem: Production State pins one repository implementation commit for the whole edition and verify_runtime_implementation rejects later changes under config/schemas/scripts/workflows. This makes it difficult to apply a reviewed generic pipeline fix discovered during the same edition, despite that iterative Issue-driven improvement being a normal and desirable production pattern.
expected_behavior: Implementation provenance should be recorded per checkpoint/action. A later stage may use newer reviewed main tooling while preserving exact provenance of earlier accepted artifacts. When a tool/schema change affects an accepted artifact contract, the agent performs targeted revalidation or migration; only unresolved compatibility ambiguity requires an Exception Gate.
actual_behavior: scripts/survey_orchestrator_v2.py verifies all implementation-control roots against state.implementation.repository_commit_sha and production-control/release workflows require current main workflow bytes to match the State-pinned worktree workflow.
production_workaround: Keep external Pilots unstarted. WU-012C must replace edition-wide toolchain lock-in with per-checkpoint implementation provenance and controlled upgrade/revalidation semantics before merge.
